messages:
Maya (eng): Cutting an RC from main now — candidate branch `rc/3.2.0-rc1` created, sha=abc123def. Proposing promo window: 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC. Need signoff from observability, SRE sheriff, and release owner.
deploy-bot: RC created: rc-3.2.0-3216549870. Artifacts uploaded -> gcr.io/redwood/runtimes:3.2.0-rc1 (pinned sha256:deadbeef...). Smoke, kv-warm, and canary configs queued.
Lennon: quick smoke ran locally — overall ok. One warning in embed-service logs (retry count bump), error rate unchanged.
Priya: Observability check: dashboards updated, sampling set to 1% for canary paths. Added telemetry assertions for p50/p95 and user-facing error rate. I can sign off on metrics.
Sam (sheriff): Ack — I'll own the post-deploy watch window. Please ensure rollback tag exists and rollback playbook is attached.
Maya (eng): Rollback plan (condensed): if p50 latency > baseline * 1.3 for 5m OR user_error_rate > baseline + 0.5% for 5m -> abort promotion and rollback to previous pinned image sha=beefcafe. Rollback cmd for ops: `kubectl set image deploy/embed embed=gcr.io/redwood/runtimes:3.1.7 --namespace=prod && kubectl rollout restart deploy/embed` — shepherd one-step rollback followed by KV-cache flush. Canary ramp: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if green.
Priya: Release notes blurb ready (short): "rc-3.2.0-rc1: performance improvements to KV warming, bugfixes for embed service retry logic, infra pinning of model-v1.7." No DB migration needed.
Lennon: Added an advisory: reranker e2e flaky in edge case (timeout on re-rank when seq_len>2048) — will monitor during canary. If it regresses, I'll hold traffic flip.
Maya (eng): Decision: proceed with scheduled promo unless ops/observability raises a hold by promo-1h. Signoffs: @Priya, @Lennon, @Sam (sheriff) — please react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Priya: :thumbsup: signed.
Lennon: :thumbsup: signed, will keep watch on reranker.
Sam (sheriff): :thumbsup: oncall ready. Rollback tag created: `rc-3.2.0-fallback` -> sha=beefcafe.
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled for 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z. Preflight checks starting: kv-warm, smoke, integration. Preflight results: kv-warm ✅, smoke ✅, e2e reranker flaky (advisory).
Maya (eng): Ops note: if reranker flake occurs during canary, trigger hold and escalate. Lennon to evaluate.
deploy-bot: Promo in progress: ramping to 5% traffic... 5% stable, running 15m window. Metrics snapshot: p95 +5%, error +0.02% (within tolerance).
deploy-bot: Increasing to 25%... 25% stable. Telemetry: p50 +7%, p95 +9% (still under alert thresholds).
Lennon: reranker check during 25% — no regression observed in sampled traces. Green from my side.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 100%... Promo complete. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. Telemetry post-promo: p95 +8% (expected), user_error_rate within baseline.
Priya: Merging release notes and final changelog entry. I'll tag the docs and add the RC tag to the release board.
Maya (eng): Great work — closing RC thread. I'll open follow-up to baseline latency across regions next week. Thanks team. :party-parrot:
